and rushed right over to her.

Ah... You're here, Trainer...
My head hurts so much, it's terrible...
choice_data_list: ...Have you been playing too many games?

text_block_list.text:
“...... That's true, but...
What, are you saying I'm some idiot who's
addicted to games and can't manage himself...?”
choice_data_list: Then you should get some proper rest.

text_block_list.text: Rulership was plagued by a headache.
